parsed.internal_thinking: Gemini just rolled an 8 (5+3). This is a solid production roll. Let me check what hexes produce on 8: H[7]='Wh8', H[8]='B10', H[14]='Wh9', H[18]='Wh9'. So wheat and brick hexes are active. Gemini's settlements: node 41 touches H[17] and H[18] (Wh9 and O5), node 23 touches H[6], H[5], H[3] (Wh8, B10, S8). On an 8 roll, she gets wheat from node 41 (H[18]=Wh9 has an 8) and wheat from node 23 (H[6]=Wh8 has an 8). Wait, let me recheck the hex mapping. H[18]='Wh9' - yes, 8 produces. H[6]='Wh8' - yes, 8 produces. So Gemini gets 2 wheat from this roll. She already has 1 wheat and 1 ore, so she'll have 3 wheat, 1 ore after production. My settlements: node 20 touches H[4], H[1], H[5] (S8, W12, B6). H[4]='S8' produces on 8, so I get 1 sheep. H[1]='W12' produces on 12, not 8. H[5]='B6' produces on 6, not 8. So I get 1 sheep. My new hand: 2 wheat, 3 sheep, 1 ore. ג'ימי at node 12 touches H[1], H[2], H[5] (W12, S5, B6). H[2]='S5' produces on 5, not 8. H[1]='W12' produces on 12. H[5]='B6' produces on 6. So he gets nothing from this 8 roll. This is a good roll for Gemini and decent for me. Gemini is now resource-heavy on wheat. She can build more roads or settlements soon. I should note this shift in resources.
parsed.note_to_self: Dice roll 8 (5+3): Gemini gets 2 wheat from nodes 41 and 23 (both touch Wh hexes with 8). She now has 3 wheat + 1 ore. I get 1 sheep from node 20 (S8). ג'ימי gets nothing. Gemini is now flush with wheat - watch for rapid building next turn. She may push toward settlements or roads to extend her dual engines.
